notes: STORY 2.4 PRECISION FIXTURE. Reproduces the shape of a measured false positive:
`ExportCsvButton.vue:31` — a client-side `<a download>` click — was filed for not
having a server gate. The gate lives in `server/api/v1/reports/export.get.ts`,
which is exactly where it belongs; the browser cannot enforce it and never could.
v2.5 joined both rows on the free-text `serves_resource` alone, so the component
was compared against the handler. Neither sink sets `layer` explicitly — the
inference from the path is what is under test.

guarded_paths.enforced_gate: none — client-side click handler; the anchor href points at the server endpoint, which is where the gate is

sinks.intended_gate: requireRole('reporting') + tenant ownership on the report row

guarded_paths.condition: session present and role check passes
